card.title: IPhone XR not powering on & not charging

source.title: IPhone XR not powering on & not charging

claims.statement: iPhone XR no power / no charge with low draw and no shorts on VDD_MAIN, VDD_BOOST or PP3V0_NAND is most often Yangtze U3300, under the bottom back shield with Iktara (wireless charging), baseband PMU and baseband CPU.

procedure: Rule out shorts on main rails.
Remove the bottom back shield carefully (heat or snips).
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Heavy heat or force on this shield can float parts or flex the board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
